title: CampaignState
description: Defines the current state of a campaign with comprehensive narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced progression systems.

campaign_id.description: Unique, machine-readable ID for the campaign, e.g., 'campaign_empire_strikes_back'.

campaign_name.description: The display name of the campaign.

era.description: The primary era this campaign is set in, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

rarity.description: How unique or special this campaign is in the galaxy.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the campaign, its themes, and significance. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote or description that captures the essence of this campaign, often from Star Wars lore.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this campaign affects different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Detailed mechanical and lore description of the campaign.

origin_story.description: The history and origin of this campaign in the galaxy.

game_mode.description: The game mode settings for this campaign.

mode_id.description: The ID of the game mode being used.

xp_multiplier.description: Multiplier for XP gain in this campaign.

session_date.description: The date of the current session.

session_summary.description: Summary of what happened in the current session.

party_level.description: The average level of the party.

party_xp.description: The total XP the party has earned.

character_ids.description: List of character IDs in the party.

next_session_prep.description: Notes for preparing the next session.

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Set In', 'Involves', 'Features', 'Centers On'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this campaign type from Star Wars canon.

famous_campaigns.description: Notable campaigns of this type from Star Wars lore.

homeworld.description: The primary setting or homeworld of this campaign.

cultural_notes.description: Important cultural information about this campaign.

roleplay_guidance.description: Guidance for roleplaying in this campaign.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements specific to this campaign.

social_dynamics.description: How this campaign affects social dynamics in the galaxy.

common_motivations.description: Common motivations and goals for characters in this campaign.

campaign_development.description: Guidance for campaign development and progression.

base_prompt.description: Base prompt for generating images of this campaign.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers for different contexts and situations.

target_type.description: The type of image being generated (e.g., 'Portrait', 'Action_Shot', 'Campaign_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Additional text to add to the prompt for this context.

image.description: Path to the campaign image file.

icon.description: Path to the campaign icon file.

color.description: Primary color associated with this campaign for UI theming.
